s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of dizziness, syncope, and shortness of breath with evidence of cardiac and respiratory compromise
salient_findings: Episodes of dizziness, syncope, and shortness of breath
Dilated right ventricle with reduced systolic function and pulmonary hypertension on echocardiogram
Acute extensive partially occlusive pulmonary emboli on CT Angiogram
key_facts: 82-year-old man
History of coronary artery disease with stent placement 10 years ago
History of surgically treated colon cancer
Heart rate: 114 beats/min
Blood pressure: 94/62 mm Hg
Oxygen saturation: 91% on 4 L/min of supplemental oxygen
Respiratory rate: 28 breaths per minute
Troponin I level: 0.135 µg/L (peaked at 0.499 µg/L)
D-dimer level: >109.52 nmol/L
N-terminal pro brain-type natriuretic peptide level: 562.21 pmol/L
Initial 12-lead electrocardiogram showed no evidence of acute myocardial ischemia or arrhythmias

shortlist.label: Pulmonary Embolism
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of dizziness, syncope, and shortness of breath with evidence of cardiac and respiratory compromise, and CT Angiogram showing acute extensive partially occlusive pulmonary emboli

shortlist.label: Acute Cor Pulmonale
shortlist.why_kept: Dilated right ventricle with reduced systolic function and pulmonary hypertension on transthoracic echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Acute Right Ventricular Failure
shortlist.why_kept: Dilated right ventricle with reduced systolic function and elevated N-terminal pro brain-type natriuretic peptide level

shortlist.label: Cardiogenic Shock
shortlist.why_kept: Hypotension, tachycardia, and elevated troponin level, suggesting cardiac compromise

shortlist.label: Submassive Pulmonary Embolism
shortlist.why_kept: CT Angiogram showing acute extensive partially occlusive pulmonary emboli and evidence of right ventricular strain

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of dizziness, syncope, and shortness of breath, combined with the laboratory findings of elevated D-dimer and troponin levels, and the imaging studies showing acute extensive partially occlusive pulmonary emboli in the distal main pulmonary arteries, are consistent with a diagnosis of pulmonary embolism.

rejected.label: Acute Cor Pulmonale
rejected.why: While the patient has signs of right ventricular strain, this is a consequence of the pulmonary embolism, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute Right Ventricular Failure
rejected.why: The right ventricular failure is secondary to the pulmonary embolism, which is the primary cause of the patient's symptoms.

rejected.label: Cardiogenic Shock
rejected.why: The patient's blood pressure is low, but the primary cause of the shock is the pulmonary embolism, not cardiogenic shock.

rejected.label: Submassive Pulmonary Embolism
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies are consistent with a massive pulmonary embolism, rather than a submassive one.
